name: Portage Lake Lift Bridge
facts: Portage Lake Lift Bridge, the world's heaviest and widest double‑decked vertical‑lift bridge, weighs 35,000 tons of concrete and 7,000 tons of steel, a colossal feat of 1959 engineering.

Designed in 1959 by Hazelet and Erdal, the bridge’s liftspan could partially raise, letting small boats pass while traffic continued; after rail service ended in 1982, the lowest position is now unused in summer.
June 2022 marked the bridge’s dedication as a National Historic Civil Engineering Landmark, honoring its pivotal role in linking Hancock and Houghton across Portage Lake.
